audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave Pantheon rows 0-3 and 'Skill' rows 4-6 while the content layer and the packet levelChart both read Diana on all seven rows.
audit.why: Cross-layer disagreement on every row. The kits support the content layer early: Comet Spear is 575 range against your 900 Q, and Shield Vault has to close 600 into your W shield.
audit.corrected: All seven sides set to Diana with every why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The ultimate was called 'Grand Skyfall' in four places. The real name is Grand Starfall, and the page claimed Diana's Ultimate 'out-ranges' it — Moonfall is 475, Grand Starfall is 5500.
audit.why: packet suspectNames flagged the name and the kit confirms it. The genuine advantage is the cooldown: Moonfall 100/90/80 against Grand Starfall 180/165/150.
audit.corrected: Name corrected everywhere and the range claim replaced with the cooldown gap that is actually true.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault's directionality was never stated, the cooldowns field held no digit, and Pantheon's auto-reset opener was missing entirely.
audit.why: Aegis Assault makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT only (22/21/20/19/18) and is a channel any CC cancels — Moonfall's pull is a hard answer to it. Shield Vault is a 600-range dash-stun that also resets his attack, so the attack wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Walk behind the shield rather than burst into it; step back on the Shield Vault wind-up; Moonfall interrupts the channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two bullets carried the tradeGood/tradeBad strings verbatim under unrelated titles ('W as you exit, not as you enter' and 'Trade inside his wave at even HP').
audit.why: Body did not answer its own title.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their titles, grounded in Pale Cascade's 9s and Mortal Will's empowered Shield Vault.
